mechanism: Rising building permits signal planned residential construction, which feeds employment, materials demand and household wealth; a pro-cyclical reading is bullish for equities.
key_finding: As known at the time (real-time PERMIT vintages), the rule selected on in-sample data uses S5_z at L13 (IS Sharpe 1.27) with held-out OOS Sharpe 0.50 versus buy-and-hold 0.92.
caveats: Building permits are revised, including annual seasonal-factor revisions; the headline uses the values as published at each date (ALFRED vintages) and the as-revised-today result is shown for comparison only.
The strategy is search-selected and needs fresh holdout validation.
The previously published rule was selected on its test-period score and is replaced here.
narrative_summary: Building permits are tested as a leading housing-cycle signal for SPY allocation.
